overall_assessment: Section extraction works very well for NIH: headings (Kort om emnet, Læringsutbytte, Læringsformer og aktiviteter, Arbeidskrav, Vurdering/eksamen, Kjernelitteratur) map cleanly, arbeidskrav are correctly kept out of assessment, and learning outcomes are complete. The only real issues are that reading_list often holds only a pointer/placeholder sentence, and the prerequisites section contains placeholder plus audience text.

findings.description: In most courses the Kjernelitteratur section holds no actual reading list, only a pointer ("Se emnearkivet", "Pensumliste for høsten 2024.", or the 2023-2024 Studiehåndbok transition sentence with a URL). The row is emitted as reading_list although it contains no bibliographic content (placeholder/boilerplate per the rubric). This reflects the source, but downstream users would treat these as real reading lists.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Kjernelitteratur heading is correctly mapped in R/section_heading_map.R, but .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R does not filter pointer-only text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R), drop reading_list rows that match ^(se emnearkivet|pensum(lista|liste) for (høsten|våren) \d{4}\.?|ettersom vi er i en overgangsfase.*)$ (case-insensitive), or flag them as pointer-only so analyses can exclude them.

findings.description: The prerequisites row consists of the placeholder "Ingen emner i programmet" (no prerequisite) followed by the answer to the separate heading "Hvem kan ta dette emnet?" ("Programstudenter LUPE"), which is an admission/target-audience statement, not a prerequisite. The heading is dropped and its text appended to prerequisites.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: "Hvem kan ta dette emnet?" is either unmapped or mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R, so its body joins the Forkrav text.
findings.suggested_fix: Map "Hvem kan ta dette emnet?" to an ignored/admin bucket in R/section_heading_map.R, and have .clean_sections() drop prerequisites rows equal to "Ingen emner i programmet" (or treat them as empty).
